name: electron-js-app

scripts.dev:electron: bun run transpile:electron && bun run transpile:preload && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.transpile:preload: bunx tsc src/electron/preload.ts --outDir dist-electron --module nodenext --target esnext --skipLibCheck
scripts.dist:mac: bun run transpile:electron && bun run transpile:preload && bun run build && bunx electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: bun run transpile:electron && bun run transpile:preload && bun run build && bunx electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: bun run transpile:electron && bun run transpile:preload && bun run build && bunx electron-builder --linux --x64

description: A modern cross-platform desktop application boilerplate using **Electron**, **React 19**, **TypeScript**, and **Vite**. This project provides a fast, maintainable, and scalable environment for building desktop apps with a web technology stack.
